bibl.title: Note critico-testuali alla prima lettera festale di Cirillo di Alessandria in copto-aḫmīmico (P. Vindob. K 10157 recto).
bibl.seg: Diego Viola, Note critico-testuali alla prima lettera festale di Cirillo di Alessandria in copto-aḫmīmico (P. Vindob. K 10157 recto).
bibl.note: Re-edition of three relevant passages from the Aḫmīmic Coptic version of Cyril of Alexandria's First Festal Letter preserved in P. Vindob. Copt. Inv. 10157 recto, along with an Italian translation and a critical and linguistic commentary. The text of the first two pericopes (II, 1-7; II, 26-32) is analysed in comparison with the extant Greek parallel version. Also, some text-critical remarks on specific lectiones of the Greek Vorlage as well as some proposals for emendation are discussed in light of the Aḫmīmic version.
